description:
About You:
We are seeking a Senior Manager of Strategic Marketing to serve as the dedicated marketing partner for our Advanced Manufacturing & Life Sciences line of business, headquartered in Raleigh, NC. This is a high-impact, highly visible role that sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, business development, and capital project intelligence. The ideal candidate brings deep fluency in the engineering and construction (E&C) industry, a working knowledge of capital project execution, and the ability to build and execute marketing programs that resonate with sophisticated industrial clients - both domestically and internationally.
This role demands someone who can operate at speed, manage complexity without losing precision, and take full ownership of outcomes that matter to the growth of the business. As ARCO's footprint in advanced manufacturing grows, this role will evolve with it - with the expectation that the right candidate will help identify and activate new market verticals as opportunities emerge.
This is not a role for someone who punches the clock and checks the box. We are looking for a marketing professional who finds a way, brings energy and precision to everything they touch, and holds themselves accountable to outcomes - not just activity. Above all, we are looking for someone who brings the full package - strategic horsepower, executional discipline, and the personal character to be the kind of marketing partner our leaders genuinely want in their corner.
A Day in the Life:
Campaign Strategy & ROI Ownership
Design, execute, and manage integrated marketing campaigns across digital, content, events, and direct channels - scoped to budget and driven by measurable outcomes
Own campaign performance from planning through reporting, with clear accountability for pipeline contribution, lead generation, and ROI delivered to the business
Manage marketing budgets with discipline and precision, making smart tradeoffs to maximize return while staying on target
Build and maintain reporting frameworks that give leadership clear, honest visibility into what is working and where to invest
Line of Business Marketing
Develop and execute integrated marketing strategies aligned to the growth objectives of the Advanced Manufacturing & Life Sciences line of business nationally
Create compelling positioning, messaging, and content that speaks to the capital project decision-making process - from site selection and feasibility through design-build delivery
Support business development with account-based marketing programs targeting key verticals including pharmaceuticals, biotech, metals, advanced materials, automotive, clean energy, and aerospace and defense manufacturing - with the flexibility and curiosity to develop programs in adjacent markets as the line of business scales
Build and execute international marketing programs targeting foreign companies evaluating U.S. manufacturing investment, partnering closely with ADB's FDI practice
Project Promotion & Jobsite Marketing
Attend project kickoff meetings and engage directly with project teams to understand the scope, complexity, and differentiating elements of what ARCO is building
Extract the story from every project - identifying the technical achievements, delivery innovations, schedule wins, and client outcomes that set ARCO apart - and translate them into compelling market-facing content
Develop and execute jobsite marketing programs that create visibility and brand credibility at the point of construction, including signage, photography, video, digital content, and milestone activations
Build a disciplined cadence of project promotion across owned, earned, and paid channels - ensuring that ARCO's executed work actively feeds the business development pipeline
Partner with project managers, operations leaders, and clients to capture content in a way that is accurate, on-brand, and respectful of confidentiality requirements
Treat every project as a proof point - connecting what we build to the markets we are targeting and the clients we want to win
Thought Leadership & Brand Credibility
Lead thought leadership content development - white papers, case studies, technical articles, event presentations, and digital campaigns - that establish ARCO as the design-build partner of choice in advanced manufacturing
Stay consistently attuned to industry trends across the verticals we serve and proactively bring creative, market-relevant ideas that connect with decision-makers in new and differentiated ways
Build ARCO's credibility, trust, and confidence with prospects, clients, and industry influencers in the advanced manufacturing and life sciences space - treating brand reputation as a long-term asset, not a campaign output
Collaboration & Stakeholder Partnership
Collaborate closely with BD leaders, sellers, and seller-doers to develop pursuit materials, capability statements, and proposal content tailored to specific verticals and regions to support our Strategic Pursuits team.
Communicate clearly and confidently with associates and executive leaders alike - including the ability to manage up effectively, bring well-reasoned recommendations, and navigate competing priorities with professionalism
Build credibility with internal leaders by consistently delivering quality work, following through on commitments, and demonstrating a clear connection between marketing activity and business results
Serve as an active contributor on strategic pursuits - bringing marketing firepower to high-value opportunities and functioning as a true team member alongside BD, pursuits, and operations leaders when the stakes are highest
Support trade show strategy, industry event participation, and sponsorship planning across domestic and international venues
Partner with ARCO's corporate marketing and communications team to ensure brand consistency while adapting messaging for technical, sophisticated audiences
Necessary Qualifications:
Experience & Industry Knowledge
8+ years of marketing experience, with a meaningful portion in the engineering, construction, or industrial/manufacturing sectors
Working knowledge of capital project execution - including design-build, EPCM, or comparable delivery models - and the ability to communicate credibly about project lifecycle, cost, and schedule
Experience marketing to or within industries such as pharmaceuticals, biotech, metals, advanced materials, automotive, clean energy, or aerospace and defense - with an appetite for learning and activating new verticals as business priorities shift
International marketing experience, including targeting foreign companies, navigating cultural nuance, and supporting FDI-related business development
Proven ability to develop high-quality technical content and thought leadership that drives engagement with senior-level industrial and real estate decision-makers
Proficiency with CRM platforms (Microsoft Dynamics 365 preferred), marketing automation tools, and digital marketing channels
Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field; advanced degree a plus
Ability to travel domestically and internationally as needed
How You Show Up
You have a winner's mentality - you find a way, and you consistently deliver what's expected plus one
You bring a high level of vigor to your work - you are energized by complexity, not slowed by it, and you operate with a sense of urgency that matches the pace of the business
You have a rare ability to absorb complex execution models, delivery structures, and technical project dynamics - and translate them into clear, compelling narratives that resonate with prospects and clients who may not speak the language of construction
You thrive in fast-paced environments where priorities shift, timelines compress, and the bar for quality stays high, regardless
You demonstrate extreme ownership - when a milestone is on the line, you do not wait to be managed, you find a way to hit it
You understand what a needle-mover pursuit looks like, and you treat strategic opportunities with the focus and intentionality they deserve - prioritizing your energy accordingly and showing up as a true partner to the BD and pursuits team
You hold yourself to a high standard of precision and attention to detail, understanding that in a credibility-driven industry, quality is non-negotiable
You are a clear, confident communicator - with peers, with BD teams, and with senior executives
You proactively manage up, bringing solutions and context rather than waiting to be directed
You are genuinely curious about the industries you support and stay ahead of trends, bringing fresh thinking that keeps ARCO relevant and differentiated
You care deeply about business performance and understand that marketing exists to drive it
You are comfortable in the field - you show up to kickoffs, ask smart questions, and know how to pull the signal out of a complex project and turn it into something the market can understand and act on
You are positive, upbeat, and genuinely enjoyable to work with - you bring energy to the room, not just output, and you understand that culture and chemistry matter in a high-performance environment
You know how to have fun in the work - celebrating wins, finding levity in the grind, and keeping the team around you motivated even when the pace is relentless
When stakes are high and pressure is real, you are the calm in the room - composed, focused, and steady in a way that gives leaders confidence and keeps pursuits and campaigns on track
You show up as a true business partner to line of business leadership - not a vendor, not a support function, but a trusted peer who is invested in the outcome and dependable when it counts most
You hold yourself to a high standard - not because someone is watching, but because that is simply who you are and how you operate
You are consistently seeking opportunities to expand your skill set, deepen your understanding of the industries and business issues you support, and sharpen your craft as a marketing professional
You are never satisfied with where the playbook is today - you are always looking for ways to level it up, and you bring those around you along in the process
You make the people and the work around you better - not by mandate, but by example
What We Can Offer You:
ARCO Design/Build is a national leader in design-build engineering and construction, delivering integrated project solutions for the world's most demanding industrial and manufacturing environments. Our Advanced Manufacturing & Life Sciences line of business serves clients across pharmaceuticals, biotech, advanced materials, metals, automotive, clean energy, aerospace and defense, and next-generation manufacturing - with a portfolio of target markets that continues to expand as U.S. industrial investment evolves.
This position represents a unique opportunity to shape the marketing strategy of one of the fastest-growing lines of business at a nationally recognized design-build firm - at a moment when advanced manufacturing investment in the U.S. is accelerating dramatically. The Manager, Accounting Systems and Operations leads the improvement, support, and
functional use of the systems, data, and processes supporting the Accounting function.

applications.

needs.

implementation plans for Technology teams and vendors.

system improvements, integrations, reporting, and automation.

upgrades, testing, and adoption.

strengthen controls, and improve the user experience.

accurate and useful financial and operational information.

process ownership.
• Partner with Technology teams to support integrations, resolve system issues, and
manage dependencies across applications.

accounting system and process concerns.

professionals.

financial systems, business analysis, or a related field.
• Experience leading accounting system implementations, enhancements,
integrations, or process-improvement initiatives.
• Strong understanding of accounting processes, financial reporting, internal
controls, and data requirements.
• Experience supporting enterprise accounting or ERP applications; experience with
Vista or Viewpoint is preferred.
• Ability to translate accounting needs into clear functional and technical
requirements.

About You:
ARCO has an exciting opportunity for a Superintendent. The ideal candidate will have five plus years working as a lead Superintendent on tilt wall construction projects. We are a growing national general contractor with a focus on light industrial, cold storage, and light manufacturing projects throughout the greater Richmond area.
The Superintendent is responsible for directly managing the construction and administrative activities associated with the field operations of a project. This person is also tasked with bringing the project to completion on schedule, within budget and per the project specifications. The Superintendent is in charge of enforcing all Safety and Quality Control policies and procedures and adhering to and implementing all company policies and regulations.
A Day in the Life:
Attend the post award review meeting to receive project information and details for preplanning prior to construction.
Participate with the project manager in preparing a schedule of construction activities and their sequence, the organization structure, staff selection, and the manpower and construction equipment requirements of the project.
Assure that adequate manpower is provided as required to meet construction schedules.
Analyze construction equipment requirements and provide necessary equipment as required to utilize manpower efficiently, and release equipment when not required.
Perform material and quantity estimates for each phase of work.
Direct and control the total construction project to meet specifications and within the allotted time schedule in an efficient manner to produce the expected profit.
Direct and supervise the activities of craft superintendents and/or foremen in the performance of their regular duties.
Determine and convey to subordinates the most efficient construction techniques to be employed to assure quality and efficiency in construction.
Assist in the activities of the project manager/engineer in their duties including prompt shipment of materials and permanent equipment, in obtaining approvals of shop drawings and material samples, in preparing and submitting all change orders.
Direct all subordinates in promptly supplying all required accounting data, conforming to all company accounting and administrative procedures.
Coordinate the activities of subcontractors to permit them to perform their work effectively and to integrate it with project schedules and progress.
Inform all supervisors and subcontractors promptly of any construction schedule changes.
Review all request for change orders with the project manager to assure adequate provisions for direct costs, overhead, profit and time extensions are accounted for and are properly documented as well as that they are submitted promptly.
Assist in the preparation of all job progress and cost reports to accurately reflect actual costs.
Review and approve all requisitions, field purchase orders, invoices, progress payment requests, and other significant reports and documents.
Cooperate with the owner and his representatives, keeping them informed of construction progress.
Cooperate with architects or owner representatives on an amicable basis, but in the long term interest of the company.
Report regularly to the project manager to keep them constantly informed on job progress, plans, and problems that could significantly affect costs or schedules.
Maintain a daily diary to permanently record all significant project facts, events, conditions, visitors, owner representative contacts, commitments, agreements and approvals.
Direct adherence to the company’s safety program in all phases and areas of the project.
Become familiar with all company policies and adhere strictly to them in all activities and dealings, and require all employees to be aware of them and conform to them in their activities.
Carry out any additional responsibilities assigned by the project manager.
Working Conditions
The majority of work is completed on job sites in an office trailer or in an existing structure. Due to daily condition changes on construction projects, when employees are outside of the office trailer or structure they must wear appropriate personal protective equipment as required by the company's safety policies and as required for weather conditions.
Necessary Qualifications:
5-25 years experience as a lead superintendent on tilt-up construction projects, preferable on jobs that are a minimum of 100k sf.
Able to make decisions under tight deadlines.
Able to organize people, tools, and equipment and plan/manage multiple activities to accomplish desired results.
Demonstrated leadership skills with ability and willingness to face challenges, direct others, and effectively address conflict.
Exhibit commitment to quality by evaluating project-related processes and making necessary changes, using customer input to make improvements, and meeting/exceeding internal and external customer expectations.
Computer skills: proficiency using Word, Excel, Outlook and project scheduling programs.
Act in a manner of integrity that shows support for the company, its values, and the employees, while maintaining constant focus on meeting/exceeding customer requirements and expectations.
Possess and maintain a current, valid driver's license in your state of residence.

PureGrid Electrical is looking for an experienced Superintendent / General Foreman who is a strong field leader, highly safety-focused, and obsessed with execution in the field. We are ARCO, a Family of Construction Companies.

Bringing the project to completion on schedule, within budget, and per the project specifications.
A Day in the Life:
Attend the post-award review meeting to receive project information and details for preplanning before construction
Participate with the project manager in preparing a schedule of construction activities and their sequence, the organization structure, staff selection, and the manpower and construction equipment requirements of the project
Direct and control the total construction project to meet specifications and within the allotted time schedule in an efficient manner to produce the expected profit
Assist the project manager/engineer in their duties including prompt shipment of materials and permanent equipment and obtaining approvals of shop drawings and material samples
Coordinate the activities of subcontractors to permit them to perform their work effectively and to integrate it with project schedules and progress
Inform all supervisors and subcontractors promptly of any construction schedule changes
Assist in the preparation of all job progress and cost reports to accurately reflect actual costs
Review and approve all requisitions, field purchase orders, invoices, and other significant reports and documents
Cooperate with the owner and his representatives, keeping them informed of construction progress
Cooperate with architects or owner representatives on an amicable basis, but in the long-term interest of the company
Hold job site meetings with project manager and the regional manager
Report regularly to the project manager to keep them constantly informed on job progress, plans, and problems that could significantly affect costs or schedules
Maintain a daily diary to permanently record all significant project facts, events, conditions, visitors, owner representative contacts, commitments, agreements, and approvals
Direct adherence to the company’s safety program in all phases and areas of the project
Make decisions under tight deadlines
Organize people, tools, and equipment and plan/manage multiple activities to accomplish desired results
Demonstrate leadership skills with ability and willingness to face challenges, direct others, and effectively address conflict
Exhibit commitment to quality by evaluating project-related processes, making necessary changes, using customer input to make improvements, and meeting/exceeding internal and external customer expectations
Act in a manner of integrity that shows support for the company, its values, and the employees while maintaining a constant focus on meeting/exceeding customer requirements and expectations
Necessary Qualifications:
1-5 years of construction experience as a superintendent on data center projects that are a minimum of 100k sq ft
Willingness to work site located in Sullivan, Indiana with travel stipends back home scheduled every other weekend.
Computer skills: proficiency in using Word, Excel, Outlook and project scheduling programs
Possess and maintain a current, valid driver's license in your state of residence
Ability to meet the physical demands of the job, including but not limited to: standing or walking for long periods of time, occasionally on uneven terrain, bending, kneeling, crouching, climbing stairs, and/or lifting heavy loads of up to 50 pounds.

Experience with operations improvement, slotting, material flow, material handling selection, and CAD-based layouts.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate data, identify trends, and develop practical recommendations.
Proficiency with AutoCAD and the ability to develop and interpret detailed layouts and drawings.
Understanding of basic process flows, lean principles, 5S, and operational improvement concepts.
Ability to evaluate operational performance, identify process gaps, develop alternative strategies, and support recommendations for change.
Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
Confident and professional presence when working with clients, project teams, vendors, and internal partners.
Ability to work independently, prioritize responsibilities, and execute project tasks with limited supervision.
Creative, adaptable, and comfortable learning new skills in a dynamic, fast-moving environment.
Willingness and ability to travel 60–80% based on project needs and location.
Previous external consulting experience is a plus, but not required.
Advanced degrees and professional certifications are welcomed.

Do you have an extreme commitment to safety? Are you a hard-working leader that never settles for less than superior quality? Do you prefer to manage the construction process from outside the trailer? If the answer is, “Yes!” then we have an exciting, long-term career opportunity for you. Who are we? We are ARCO, a Family of Construction Companies.
You’ll need 5-25 years of experience leading ground-up, light industrial construction projects, 100K sq ft and above. You’ll have the opportunity to manage the construction and administrative activities associated with the field operations of a project from day one! Bringing the project to completion on schedule, within budget, and per the project specifications.
A Day in the Life:
Attend the post-award review meeting to receive project information and details for preplanning before construction
Participate with the project manager in preparing a schedule of construction activities and their sequence, the organization structure, staff selection, and the manpower and construction equipment requirements of the project
Direct and control the total construction project to meet specifications and within the allotted time schedule in an efficient manner to produce the expected profit
Assist the project manager/engineer in their duties including prompt shipment of materials and permanent equipment and obtaining approvals of shop drawings and material samples
Coordinate the activities of subcontractors to permit them to perform their work effectively and to integrate it with project schedules and progress
Inform all supervisors and subcontractors promptly of any construction schedule changes
Assist in the preparation of all job progress and cost reports to accurately reflect actual costs
Review and approve all requisitions, field purchase orders, invoices, and other significant reports and documents
Cooperate with the owner and his representatives, keeping them informed of construction progress
Cooperate with architects or owner representatives on an amicable basis, but in the long-term interest of the company
Hold job site meetings with project manager and the regional manager
Report regularly to the project manager to keep them constantly informed on job progress, plans, and problems that could significantly affect costs or schedules
Maintain a daily diary to permanently record all significant project facts, events, conditions, visitors, owner representative contacts, commitments, agreements, and approvals
Direct adherence to the company’s safety program in all phases and areas of the project
Make decisions under tight deadlines
Organize people, tools, and equipment and plan/manage multiple activities to accomplish desired results
Demonstrate leadership skills with ability and willingness to face challenges, direct others, and effectively address conflict
Exhibit commitment to quality by evaluating project-related processes, making necessary changes, using customer input to make improvements, and meeting/exceeding internal and external customer expectations
Act in a manner of integrity that shows support for the company, its values, and the employees while maintaining a constant focus on meeting/exceeding customer requirements and expectations
Necessary Qualifications:
5-25 years of construction experience, with at least 5 of those years as a lead superintendent on warehouse or distribution center projects that are a minimum of 100k sq ft
Willing to travel nationally
Computer skills: proficiency in using Word, Excel, Outlook and project scheduling programs
Possess and maintain a current, valid driver's license in your state of residence
Ability to meet the physical demands of the job, including but not limited to: standing or walking for long periods of time, occasionally on uneven terrain, bending, kneeling, crouching, climbing stairs, and/or lifting heavy loads of up to 50 pounds.
What We Can Offer You:
We are dedicated to the well-being of our associates and are proud to be consistently recognized as a Best Place to Work. Our compensation and benefits package not only supports our associates and their families but benefits local communities and communities around the world.
Vehicle allowance, per diem, and living expenses on traveling jobs
An airplane ticket home every 2 weeks when traveling
Business expenses and mileage reimbursement
Industry-leading performance-based bonus program
Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
Traditional and Roth 401k
Tuition reimbursement for associates
Scholarship for associates’ children up to $28,000 per child
1-month paid sabbatical after every five years of employment, plus $5,000 for travel
1-week paid volunteer leave each year
100% charitable match
Medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage
100% paid 12-week maternity leave

description:
About You:
ARCO Design/Build has an exciting opportunity for a Superintendent. The ideal candidate will have five plus years working as a lead Superintendent on Food Processing & Manufacturing construction projects.
The Superintendent is responsible for directly managing the construction and administrative activities associated with the field operations of food processing and food manufacturing projects. This person is tasked with bringing complex food facility projects to completion on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with project specifications, food safety requirements, quality standards, and applicable regulations. The Superintendent coordinates the construction of core and shell, process areas, equipment installation, and supporting utilities, while working closely with owners, design teams, subcontractors, equipment suppliers, and other vendors through commissioning, start-up, and operational turnover. The Superintendent is in charge of enforcing all Safety and Quality Control policies and procedures and adhering to and implementing all company policies and regulations.
A Day in the Life:
Attend the post award review meeting to receive project information and details for preplanning prior to construction.
Participate with the project manager in preparing a schedule of construction activities and their sequence, the organization structure, staff selection, and the manpower and construction equipment requirements of the project.
Assure that adequate manpower is provided as required to meet construction schedules.
Analyze construction equipment requirements and provide necessary equipment as required to utilize manpower efficiently, and release equipment when not required.
Perform material and quantity estimates for each phase of work.
Direct and control the total construction project to meet specifications and within the allotted time schedule in an efficient manner to produce the expected profit.
Direct and supervise the activities of craft superintendents and/or foremen in the performance of their regular duties.
Determine and convey to subordinates the most efficient construction techniques to be employed to assure quality and efficiency in construction.
Assist in the activities of the project manager/engineer in their duties including prompt shipment of materials and permanent equipment, in obtaining approvals of shop drawings and material samples, in preparing and submitting all change orders.
Direct all subordinates in promptly supplying all required accounting data, conforming to all company accounting and administrative procedures.
Coordinate the activities of subcontractors to permit them to perform their work effectively and to integrate it with project schedules and progress.
Inform all supervisors and subcontractors promptly of any construction schedule changes.
Review all request for change orders with the project manager to assure adequate provisions for direct costs, overhead, profit and time extensions are accounted for and are properly documented as well as that they are submitted promptly.
Assist in the preparation of all job progress and cost reports to accurately reflect actual costs.
Review and approve all requisitions, field purchase orders, invoices, progress payment requests, and other significant reports and documents.
Cooperate with the owner and his representatives, keeping them informed of construction progress.
Cooperate with architects or owner representatives on an amicable basis, but in the long term interest of the company.
Report regularly to the project manager to keep them constantly informed on job progress, plans, and problems that could significantly affect costs or schedules.
Maintain a daily diary to permanently record all significant project facts, events, conditions, visitors, owner representative contacts, commitments, agreements and approvals.
Direct adherence to the company’s safety program in all phases and areas of the project.
Become familiar with all company policies and adhere strictly to them in all activities and dealings, and require all employees to be aware of them and conform to them in their activities.
Carry out any additional responsibilities assigned by the project manager.
Necessary Qualifications:
5–10 years of experience as a lead superintendent on food and beverage projects, preferably projects of at least 100,000 square feet. Experience should include all phases of facility construction, including sitework, building shell construction, process equipment installation, commissioning, start-up, and operational turnover.
Experience coordinating multiple vendors, process equipment suppliers, subcontractors, and owner representatives throughout construction, equipment installation, commissioning, and start-up.
Demonstrated experience managing food safety requirements throughout construction and enforcing compliance with food safety design criteria across all project phases.
Preferred experience with both greenfield food manufacturing projects and work within operational facilities, including process line additions and other modifications. Demonstrated understanding of the sequencing and phasing required to execute projects safely and efficiently while maintaining ongoing operations.
Ability to make decisions under tight deadlines.
Ability to organize people, tools, and equipment and plan and manage multiple activities to accomplish desired results.
Demonstrated leadership skills, with the ability and willingness to face challenges, direct others, and effectively address conflict.
Exhibit commitment to quality by evaluating project-related processes and making necessary changes, using customer input to make improvements, and meeting/exceeding internal and external customer expectations.
Computer proficiency, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and project scheduling programs.

job_title: Human Resources Business Partner, Germany | AXS
description:
THE COMPANY
AXS is a global ticketing provider for venues, sports clubs, and live events, delivering innovative ticketing, data, and marketing solutions. In Germany, AXS plays a central role in the live entertainment ecosystem through its close connection with Anschutz Entertainment Group, Inc. (AEG), the independent, globally operating entertainment group behind many of the country’s most prominent venues. These include Berlin’s Uber Arena and Uber Eats Music Hall, as well as Hamburg’s Barclays Arena.
AXS is responsible for ticketing for AEG Presents, one of the world’s leading organizers of tours, festivals, and concerts. Fans of internationally renowned artists such as Taylor Swift, Ed Sheeran, Kylie Minogue, Katy Perry, and BLACKPINK rely on AXS to access unforgettable live events, including globally celebrated festivals such as Coachella and major concert series across Europe.
As part of AXS Europe, we are a preferred ticketing partner for some of the largest venues and festivals across the continent. Using the latest technology, we seamlessly guide fans through every stage of the event life cycle - from ticket discovery and purchase to venue access and beyond. Our revolutionary digital platforms are designed to deliver an intuitive, high-quality user experience that makes live entertainment more accessible and enjoyable.
Founded in 2011, AXS has consistently driven innovation within the ticketing industry, improving how fans discover events, find the perfect seats, and connect with live experiences. From our European headquarters in London and across our teams throughout Germany, wider Europe, and the US, we continue to evolve the industry with dedicated, diverse teams working in a dynamic, fast‑paced environment.
We are passionate about enhancing the fan experience and providing game‑changing solutions for our partners and clients in Germany and beyond. With a strong culture, exciting benefits, and a shared love for live entertainment, we’re always looking for motivated people ready to bring new ideas and help keep the world cheering.
THE ROLE
As People & Culture Business Partner for Germany, you will play a key role in supporting local leaders and teams while partnering closely with European and Global People & Culture leadership to implement and uphold AXS’s people strategy. You will act as a trusted advisor to the German business, balancing local market needs, German labour law requirements, and cultural nuances with European and global initiatives.
This role has a strong focus on culture building, organisational development, integration, and harmonisation, supporting AXS as it continues to evolve and grow across Germany and Europe.
YOU
You are a trusted People & Culture professional with strong expertise across the employee lifecycle and a solid understanding of German labour law within a European and global context. You are comfortable navigating complex people topics - such as organisational change, integration, and harmonisation - and partnering closely with leaders, works councils, and People & Culture colleagues across regions and time zones.
You are highly organised, proactive, and confident engaging with diverse stakeholder groups, from frontline managers to senior executives. You excel at translating People & Culture strategies, policies, and data into clear, practical guidance that enables leaders to make informed, people‑centric decisions.
You care deeply about building inclusive, high‑performing cultures, supporting employee engagement and development, and embedding AXS values into everyday behaviours and ways of working. Above all, you are motivated by the opportunity to contribute to a growing, international People & Culture function - helping shape an evolving organisation while balancing local needs with European and global priorities.
Strategic HR & Business Partnership
Partner with German leaders and stakeholders to translate global and European People & Culture strategies into impactful local initiatives.
Support executives and senior leaders on people, culture, and organisational topics aligned with AXS’s business goals.
Act as the primary People & Culture interface for AXS Germany, reporting directly to the VP, People & Culture, Europe.
Collaborate closely with European and Global People & Culture leadership to ensure alignment, consistency, and best‑practice sharing.
Culture, Integration & Harmonisation
Actively shape and strengthen AXS culture in Germany in line with global values, behaviours, and engagement ambitions.
Lead and support integration and harmonisation initiatives across Germany, ensuring consistency in people processes, policies, and ways of working while respecting local requirements.
Design and deliver culture, engagement, and employee experience initiatives, including follow‑up actions from annual engagement surveys.
Support change and transformation initiatives, acting as a coach and sounding board for leaders and teams.
Employee Lifecycle & Organisational Development
Own and support the full employee lifecycle in Germany - from workforce planning, recruitment, onboarding, and development through to offboarding.
Further develop learning, talent, and development initiatives, including performance management, feedback processes, compensation, and bonus cycles.
Support succession planning and talent reviews in partnership with European People & Culture colleagues.
Recruitment & Employer Branding
Plan and support recruitment activities in Germany to enable sustainable growth and attract top talent.
Partner with hiring managers on recruitment strategy, selection, and decision‑making.
Contribute to and implement local employer branding initiatives that strengthen AXS’s reputation as an employer of choice in Germany.
HR Operations, Reporting & Compliance
Partner closely with Finance to support payroll and benefits administration, including data validation, monthly payroll inputs, benefits enrolment and lifecycle management (joiners, changes, leavers), reporting, and ensuring accuracy, compliance, and a positive employee experience across all related processes.
Partner with Global People & Culture and local teams on HR reporting, including headcount, personnel metrics, and cost reporting.
Advise managers on German labour law, employee relations, and works council matters where applicable.
Ensure compliance with local labour laws and internal policies while supporting the harmonisation of HR practices across Europe.
KEY SKILLS & EXPERIENCE
Several years of experience as an HR Business Partner, HR Generalist, or in a comparable role within a dynamic, fast‑paced environment, with strong expertise across the full employee lifecycle including recruitment and talent management.
Proven experience supporting organisational change, transformation, and organisational development initiatives, with the ability to identify practical, business‑aligned solutions to emerging challenges.
Strong relationship‑building skills with a demonstrated ability to establish trust and credibility with leaders, managers, and employees at all levels.
Confident communicator with excellent verbal and written skills, able to influence stakeholders positively, navigate complexity, and collaborate effectively across teams and functions.
Highly organised with a structured, detail‑oriented approach; able to manage multiple priorities, handle high volumes of work, and maintain accuracy under pressure.
Team‑oriented mindset with a track record of contributing to shared goals, fostering collaboration, and building strong professional relationships across departments.
Strong affinity for HR systems, data, and tools, with the ability to leverage insights to support decision‑making and continuous improvement.
Exceptional German and English language skills, with experience working in international environments (ideally with US‑based teams), combined with a flexible, positive attitude and a genuine passion for the live entertainment industry.
DESIRABLE
A degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Labour Law, or a related field, or a recognised HR qualification.

ROLLE: IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d)
BERICHTET AN: IT-Manager Europa
AXS ist ein führender Anbieter fortschrittlicher Ticketing- und Live-Event-Technologie und in Nordamerika, Europa und im asiatisch-pazifischen Raum aktiv. Das Unternehmen ermöglicht den Zugang zu einigen der weltweit bekanntesten Veranstaltungsorte, Sportteams, Festivals und Welttourneen. Mit maßgeschneiderten Ticketing-Lösungen, innovativer Technologie und engagiertem Kundenservice arbeitet AXS mit über 1.600 der renommiertesten Marken aus Sport und Unterhaltung zusammen – darunter die Olympischen und Paralympischen Spiele 28 in Los Angeles, die Eisbären in Berlin, das Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival, das Red Rocks Amphitheatre, First Avenue, die O2 Arena, die BNP Paribas Open, die WM Phoenix Open und das Stagecoach Country Music Festival, sowie die Barclays Arena in Hamburg und die Uber Eats Music Hall in Berlin. Position Summary:
AXS is seeking a Lead Product Manager to define and execute the vision for our next-generation Commerce Platform, a foundational capability within our enterprise tooling that powers how products are defined, priced, taxed, settled, and presented across the AXS ecosystem.
This role owns the strategy, vision, and delivery of the Commerce Configuration Framework, which is a foundational platform that introduces modern, configurable commerce services for inventory definition, pricing composition, contractual revenue allocation, taxation, consumer price presentation, and financial governance.
Success in this role requires balancing platform modernization, regulatory compliance, financial integrity, operational scalability, and client flexibility while delivering reusable platform capabilities that support AXS' long-term global commerce strategy.
The ideal candidate combines exceptional product leadership with deep technical and business acumen. You are comfortable discussing APIs, configuration frameworks, financial systems, distributed services, pricing engines, taxation, settlement, and platform architecture with engineering teams while translating those concepts into scalable business capabilities.
You will partner closely with Engineering, Architecture, Finance, Client Operations, Ticketing Operations, and Executive Leadership to build one of the most strategic platform investments within our enterprise platform.
Essential Functions:
As a Lead Product Manager you will be accountable for:
Defining the long-term vision, roadmap, and product strategy for the Commerce Platform.
Establishing reusable commerce primitives supporting inventory definition, pricing composition, contractual revenue allocation, taxability, and consumer presentation.
Leading the modernization of legacy pricing and fee architectures into configurable platform services.
Driving platform capabilities including:
SKU Management
Pricing Composition
Revenue Attribution
Taxability Services partnering with 3rd party APIs
Governance and Configuration Frameworks
Partnering with Engineering and Architecture to define scalable service boundaries, APIs, data models, and platform extensibility.
Developing platform capabilities supporting global regulatory requirements, fee transparency, taxation models, and regional market differences.
Partnering with Finance and Settlement teams to improve financial transparency, reporting accuracy, and reconciliation.
Working closely with Client Operations and Ticketing Operations to reduce manual configuration effort and operational complexity.
Defining governance models, configuration guardrails, inheritance strategies, and reusable templates that improve consistency while maintaining client flexibility.
Drive migration strategy from legacy fee constructs to the modern commerce platform while minimizing operational disruption.
Define KPIs measuring adoption, operational efficiency, financial accuracy, configuration quality, and platform health.
Build alignment across Product, Engineering, Finance, Operations, Architecture, Compliance, and Executive Leadership.
Communicate roadmap, risks, dependencies, and strategic outcomes across technical and executive audiences.
We are looking for:
Required qualifications
7+ years of Product Management experience delivering complex software platforms in Agile environments.
Experience owning highly configurable platform products, enterprise software, or commerce platforms.
Demonstrated success defining products that span multiple engineering teams and organizational domains.
Strong understanding of modern commerce concepts including pricing, taxation, settlement, financial systems, or revenue management.
Experience partnering closely with engineering teams building APIs, configuration platforms, distributed systems, or platform infrastructure.
Experience modernizing legacy systems while balancing operational continuity and long-term platform evolution.
Strong systems-thinking mindset capable of connecting customer workflows, financial processes, technical architecture, and operational execution.
Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.
Excellent communication and executive presentation skills.
Strong analytical skills with experience using quantitative and qualitative data to guide product strategy.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience building configurable commerce, payments, pricing, taxation, ERP, or financial platform products.
Experience with pricing engines, product catalog services, settlement platforms, or revenue attribution systems.
Familiarity with tax orchestration providers and global taxation concepts including VAT, GST, and US sales tax.
Experience designing platform governance, inheritance models, or configurable business rules engines.
Knowledge of financial reconciliation, accounting workflows, or enterprise reporting systems.
Experience with platform migrations involving legacy modernization.
Experience working within highly regulated industries.
Background in ticketing, eCommerce, payments, fintech, SaaS, ERP, hospitality, travel, or marketplaces.

Supporting global event operations by balancing the needs of diverse venue partners, regional workflows, and access control technologies across international markets.

Working closely with Field Operations and Client Services teams to identify operational pain points and prioritize improvements that reduce friction for venues and fans.

Lead modernization efforts across legacy ingress and access control systems while maintaining operational continuity.

Communicate roadmap, risks, priorities, and outcomes clearly across technical teams, business stakeholders, and executive leadership.
Build alignment across diverse stakeholder groups and influence decisions through data-driven insights and customer understanding.

The Vice President of Data Engineering will lead AXS' global data engineering organization, owning the strategy, architecture, and operation of the data platforms, pipelines, and infrastructure that power personalization, analytics, fraud prevention, pricing, and reporting across the business. Oversee the design, build, and operation of scalable data pipelines (batch and real-time) that ingest, transform, and serve data reliably across the business.
Lead the evolution of AXS' data lake/warehouse architecture, ensuring performance, cost efficiency, and reliability at high transaction volume.

Provide clear communication and progress updates to the CTO and senior leadership.
Manage operating budgets and resources effectively, ensuring financial accountability and sustainable growth.

Data at Scale: Experience building and operating high-volume data platforms supporting consumer-facing, e-commerce, or transactional systems.
Strategic Execution: Demonstrated success defining and delivering data platform roadmaps, managing multiple initiatives end-to-end, and scaling data engineering organizations.
Technical Depth: Strong background with modern data stacks — data warehousing (Snowflake, Redshift, or BigQuery), orchestration (Airflow, dbt), streaming/event-driven systems (Kafka, Kinesis), and scalable cloud platforms (preferably AWS).
Data Infrastructure & Reliability: Expertise in data pipeline architecture, data quality frameworks, observability, CI/CD, and SRE practices to ensure high reliability and data trust.
Databases & Storage: Skilled with enterprise and NoSQL databases (Oracle, DynamoDB, Snowflake, etc.) and designing systems for personalization, analytics, and real-time decisioning.

description:
Beyond powers the business of short-term rentals with a best-in-class Revenue Management System used by thousands of property managers and owners around the world. We’re profitable, growing fast, and building with the latest technologies—including AI—to help our customers unlock more revenue with less effort. Behind our product is a global team of 180+ Beyonders who bring curiosity, craft, and care to everything we do. We believe people are the most important part of any business, starting with ours.
It's with that in mind that Beyond is looking to add a Customer Success Manager to our growing team. Reporting to our Manager of Customer Success SMB, EMEA, you will have the opportunity to be a key asset in developing and executing our strategy. This is an exciting opportunity for someone with a solid grasp of customer success processes who’s looking to take their expertise and build something new! You’ll develop & implement new processes, drive the results of the initiative, and serve as a go-to resource for other team members.
Before reading further...
Beyond is passionate about diversity and cultivating our team’s potential. If you’re hungry for a good opportunity, but don't meet every point in this job description, please apply anyway!
As our Customer Success Manager, you'll be responsible for:
Acting as the first point of contact for all SMB clients' journey with Beyond
Hosting training webinars on revenue management best practices and how to effectively use our tool to increase revenue
Performing regular check-ins with key stakeholders to ensure customer goals are being met
Proactively managing  relationships with  accounts to maintain overall customer  health
Monitoring and reporting on the health and risk of accounts
Securing annual subscription renewals
Responding to requests for support in a timely manner
Documenting learnings to assist troubleshooting efforts of other team members
Proactively creating expert customer content (e.g. helpdesk articles, videos, training quizzes) to guide our customers
Contributing to the development of customer support processes as our customer base continues to grow
So what kind of person are we looking for in this role? The person who will be successful in this role will be:
Curious: you are curious by nature and have a knack for learning the ins and outs of software and a desire to dive into issues tp understand what is going on beneath the surface
Empathetic: you are able to understand customer pain points and genuine desire to help our customers resolve issues
People and Customer-Centric: you enjoy working with people and are driven to provide an excellent customer experience. You pride yourself on going above and beyond for teammates and customers
Creative: you have the drive to identify creative ways to improve the customer experience and suggest new, out-of-the-box idea
Now that we’ve told you what the job looks like, here are the qualifications we're looking for in a candidate:
1 to a maximum of 2 years of relevant experience in Customer Success Manager/Account Management
Spanish, French and full proficiency in English is needed
Experience communicating difficult, technical concepts with customers in a professional and thoughtful way
Experience in balancing multiple tasks and customer needs simultaneously. Ability to prioritize your workday independently
Ability to handle working in a fast-paced work environment
Experience working with software (Saas exposure)
So what can you expect after you apply? Your application will be personally reviewed by a member of the Beyond hiring team and if there is a match in your experience and the role, you will:
Have a video conversation with someone on our Recruiting team. This is a high-level conversation about your experience and interest, but also an opportunity for you to learn more about us
Meet with our Manager of Customer Experience, EMEA for a deeper dive video conversation
Complete an assignment relevant to the role and meet with a few additional members of the Customer Experience team
Have a final interview with a member of our Executive team
Company Values:
We are serious about our core values: We Care, We Are On the Same Team, We Inspire Trust, We Go Beyond, We Ship It, We're Curious. If those resonate with you, and you're ready to work with a team that lives and breathes those values, we want to hear from you.
Benefits:
Beyond offers a wide variety of benefits like: stock options, unlimited PTO, private health insurance and more! You can learn more about our benefits by visiting our careers site!
We Care about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion:
Beyond is committed to building a workplace that attracts humans of all genders, ethnicities, backgrounds, statuses and lifestyles. At our core, we care about our people and encourage every employee, partner and applicant to share their whole self with us. We are respectful of and empathetic towards different viewpoints, and believe that our ability to help short term rental managers succeed relies on us building a dynamic and diverse team. Whoever you are, you can Belong @ Beyond.
AI Policy:
At Beyond, We Inspire Trust. In each other, in our process, and in the people we bring onto the team. As part of that commitment, we’re implementing clear guidelines around the use of AI in our recruitment processes. Please review the full policy here.
Any communication regarding job openings, interviews and/or offers will come from our @beyondpricing.com email domain
Please review our GDPR Statement here.

Company Overview:
Blink Health is the fastest growing healthcare technology company that builds products to make prescriptions accessible and affordable to everybody. Our two primary products – BlinkRx and Quick Save – remove traditional roadblocks within the current prescription supply chain, resulting in better access to critical medications and improved health outcomes for patients.
BlinkRx is the world’s first pharma-to-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world-class support on this first-of-its-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can’t afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn’t have the medication in stock.
We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us!
We're seeking Bilingual Customer Support Specialists - Spanish, Cantonese, Korean, or Vietnamese proficiency required
This is a fully On-site role located at 400 S Woods Mill Rd, Chesterfield, Missouri
Responsibilities:
Receive inbound phone calls to resolve routine and new issues with patients, doctors and insurers
Provide patient care to accurately support pharma programs and triage to appropriate teams when required
Strive to meet and exceed structured performance targets.
Document all call information and data discovery according to operating procedures
Utilize Knowledge Base materials as a foundation for resolving inquiries
Maintain confidentiality of patient and proprietary information
Develop a working knowledge of company related security and privacy practices.
Participate in continued education on product changes, new features and product launches
Help improve the patient experience by sharing feedback with management to further develop the product, materials and processes
Requirements:
Bilingual proficiency required: Spanish, Cantonese, Korean, or Vietnamese, with strong command of the English language
High school diploma or GED required, Bachelor’s degree strongly preferred
Customer service or inbound call center experience required
Healthcare, pharmacy or other relevant industry experience strongly preferred
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Sound technical skills, analytical ability, good judgment, and strong operational focus
A passion for providing top-notch patient care
Ability to work with peers in a team effort and cross-functionally
Strong technical aptitude and ability to learn complex new software
Location/Hours:
Availability Monday-Friday 7am-8pm and every 3rd Sat rotation 8am-4pm
Scheduling flexibility, as your schedule may change over time according to business needs
Benefits:
Health, Dental & Vision – Multiple plan options from day 1
Well-being Support – Employee Assistance Program with counseling, wellness coaching, legal/financial advice, and more
Vacation – Accrue up to 80 hours (2 weeks) in year one
Paid Sick Time – 40 hours per year
Holidays – 9 paid holidays + 2 floating holidays per year
Parental Leave – 12 weeks paid (birthing) / 4 weeks paid (non-birthing), including adoption and foster placement
401(k) – Traditional and Roth options
Life & Disability Insurance – Provided at no cost
Commuter Benefits – Free onsite parking + pre-tax commuter FSA+ Free shuttle service (Pittsburgh, PA only)
Snack & Drink Stipend – Daily at all pharmacy locations
What You’ll Do
Connect with patients via phone, email, and chat to guide them through enrollment, onboarding, and prescription fulfillment
Conduct outbound outreach to support patients in completing key steps in their prescription journey
Serve as a central point of coordination between patients, providers, and insurers to resolve issues efficiently
Assist with insurance verification, benefits coordination, and financial assistance programs
Support pharmaceutical program requirements and triage clinical questions to pharmacists or appropriate teams
Research and resolve patient issues using internal tools and resources
Accurately document all interactions and key insights to ensure a seamless patient experience
Meet and exceed performance goals related to quality, productivity, and patient satisfaction
Identify trends or gaps in the patient experience and share feedback to improve processes and products
Maintain strict confidentiality and handle sensitive patient information in compliance with HIPAA and company policies
Continuously learn and adapt to new products, workflows, and program updates
What Success Looks Like
Patients feel supported, informed, and confident throughout their journey
Issues are resolved quickly and accurately across multiple channels
You become a trusted resource for patients and internal teams
You actively contribute ideas to improve the patient experience
You grow your skills and take on increasing responsibility over time
Qualifications
High school diploma or GED required; Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree is a plus
Those with a passion for helping others are welcome (we provide comprehensive training); prior customer service experience in retail, call center, or other customer-facing environments is a plus
Strong communication skills (verbal and written)
Comfortable using technology and learning new systems quickly
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Curious, adaptable, and eager to learn
Self-starter with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
Passion for helping others and delivering high-quality patient care
Ability to work collaboratively across teams

Full-time, hourly role
On-site: 5 Penn Center Blvd, Robinson Township, Pittsburgh, PA
Multiple scheduling options available, including 4-day workweeks
Shifts scheduled between Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 9:00 PM EST
Rotating Saturday shifts (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST)
Schedules may evolve based on business needs

We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us!
Location: On site-400 South Woods Mills Rd, Suite 100, Chesterfield MO
Hours: Part-time, hourly- 20 hrs/week. Available shifts:
2 10 hour shifts - Mon/Tues or Wed/Thurs or Sat/Sun 7am- 5pm
5 days in office Mon- Fri, 9am - 1pm
The Opportunity:
As a BlinkRx Pharmacist, you are the clinical backbone of our closed-door facility. You will verify prescriptions with speed and precision, provide proactive phone-based patient counseling, and collaborate with prescribers to keep medications moving without compromising safety. This role is ideal for pharmacists who thrive in a structured, high-throughput environment and are passionate about improving patient outcomes at scale.
Responsibilities:
Prescription Verification and Dispensing
Review and clinically verify new and refill prescriptions for therapeutic appropriateness, drug-drug interactions, contraindications, and dosing accuracy
Validate prescription data entry performed by pharmacy technicians, ensuring transcription accuracy from provider orders and transfer records
Perform pharmacist verification of filled prescriptions in a closed-door fulfillment environment, confirming accuracy of drug, dose, quantity, NDC, and labeling prior to release for shipment
Perform daily prospective drug utilization review (DUR) to identify and resolve clinical flags before fulfillment
Manage specialty medication handling requirements including cold-chain verification
Patient Care
All patient interaction at BlinkRx is conducted by phone or digital platforms. Our pharmacists are the primary clinical contact for patients and must deliver a high standard of care in every call.
Provide proactive outbound patient counseling calls for new prescriptions, addressing drug education, expected side effects, dosing instructions, storage requirements, and adherence strategies
Handle inbound clinical patient calls related to counseling and clinical inquiries, while directing non-clinical inquiries, such as refill status and delivery questions, to the patient support team.
Document all patient interactions thoroughly in the patient profile within the pharmacy management system
Support Spanish-speaking patients with bilingual counseling where applicable
Prescriber Collaboration and Clinical Outreach
Contact prescriber offices via phone and electronic messaging to clarify incomplete, ambiguous, or clinically inappropriate prescriptions prior to dispensing
Partner with prescribers on therapeutic substitutions, DAW overrides, and formulary alternatives to reduce dispensing delays
Pharmacy Technician Supervision and Workflow Management
Supervise pharmacy technicians across data entry, prescription processing, packaging, and fulfillment workflows in accordance with state board regulations and in collaboration with technician management
Conduct real-time quality checks on technician work product, providing immediate corrective feedback to maintain accuracy standards
Identify and escalate technician performance trends to pharmacy leadership; participate in coaching and training as directed
Compliance, Safety and Quality
Ensure strict compliance with HIPAA, state pharmacy practice acts, federal DEA regulations, and all BlinkRx corporate policies
Oversee proper handling, documentation, and destruction of PHI-containing records and materials in alignment with privacy protocols
Participate in quality assurance activities including internal audits, prescription error tracking, and near-miss reporting
Report adverse drug events and medication errors through established pharmacovigilance channels, when applicable
Maintain fulfillment area compliance standards, including proper storage of temperature-sensitive medications
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Collaborate with pharmacy leadership, patient services, clinical, compliance, and technology teams to drive operational and clinical improvements
Coordinate with the shipping and fulfillment team to resolve packaging errors, return-to-sender issues, and delivery failures affecting patient medication access
Provide clinical input on technology enhancements, workflow tools, and software configurations that affect the pharmacist verification or patient counseling experience
Participate in team huddles, quality reviews, and department meetings to support continuous improvement initiatives
Qualifications:
Required
Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) degree from an ACPE-accredited College of Pharmacy
Active Missouri Pharmacy License in good standing with the Missouri Board of Pharmacy
Strong command of the English language (written and verbal); bilingual Spanish preferred for phone-based patient counseling
Demonstrated ability to perform high-volume prescription verification with strong attention to detail and accuracy
Strong technical aptitude and ability to learn pharmacy management systems, verification platforms, and internal workflow tools
Preferred
3+ years of experience in a mail order, specialty, retail or closed-door fulfillment pharmacy
Active pharmacy licensure required in home state; candidates must obtain licensure in 3 additional states from the list below within the first 9 months of hire (prior licensure in any of the following states is a plus):
AK, AL, AR, CA, ID, IL, KS, KY, LA, MA, MD, MI, MS, NE, NV, OK, OR, TN, TX, VA, WV
Familiarity with pharmacovigilance or adverse drug event reporting protocols
What Success Looks Like:
Prescription verification queues are processed accurately and on time without sacrificing clinical quality
Every patient who receives a counseling call feels informed, supported, and confident in their therapy
Prescriber outreach is proactive and efficient, minimizing dispensing delays caused by incomplete or unclear orders
Compliance and quality standards are upheld without exception in a fast-paced environment
You are a trusted clinical partner within the BlinkRx team — shaping the patient experience from behind the scenes
Benefits:
Health, Dental & Vision – Multiple plan options from day 1
Well-being Support – Employee Assistance Program with counseling, wellness coaching, legal/financial advice, and more
Vacation – Accrue up to 80 hours (2 weeks) in year one
Paid Sick Time – 40 hours per year
Holidays – 9 paid holidays + 2 floating holidays per year
Parental Leave – 12 weeks paid (birthing) / 4 weeks paid (non-birthing), including adoption and foster placement
401(k) – Traditional and Roth options
Life & Disability Insurance – Provided at no cost
Commuter Benefits – Free onsite parking + pre-tax commuter FSA+ Free shuttle service (Pittsburgh, PA only)
Snack & Drink Stipend – Daily at all pharmacy locations

The Role: As our Senior Instructional Designer, AI & Simulation Enablement, you'll drive our organization's shift toward AI-powered, simulation-based training. You won't just write training content — you'll design, build, and continuously improve realistic practice environments, from conversational role-play scenarios to procedural and technical simulations, that let employees rehearse high-stakes skills safely, repeatedly, and at scale. This role sits deliberately at the intersection of three disciplines: instructional design, live facilitation, and Product/Engineering. You'll translate learning needs into technical requirements that designers or Product and Engineering can build against, and translate those outputs back into the classroom experience for our learners. Success means simulation-based training that is both instructionally sound and technically scalable — and that demonstrably improves performance.
This is a hybrid role based in either New York or Seattle location
What you’ll do:
Simulation Design & Strategy
Design branching scenarios, role-play conversations, and procedural/technical simulations grounded in adult learning principles and real on-the-job situations.
Define what “realistic” and “effective” mean for each simulation — personas, difficulty curves, failure states, and feedback loops — in partnership with SMEs and facilitators.
Build and maintain a simulation roadmap aligned to the organization’s highest-priority skill gaps, rather than defaulting to whichever tool is easiest to deploy.
AI Tooling, Prompt Engineering & Build
Own the prompt engineering and configuration behind AI-driven simulations (conversational AI role-play, AI-generated scenario content, adaptive difficulty), working within licensed platforms and/or custom-built tools.
Evaluate and pilot AI simulation vendors and in-house technologies (e.g., conversational role-play platforms, authoring tools with AI generation, avatar/voice tools) against defined learning outcomes and total cost of ownership.
Maintain a working knowledge of the AI/LLM capabilities and constraints relevant to training use cases, translating this into realistic scope and timelines.
Bridging Instructional Design, Facilitation & Product/Engineering
Act as the primary liaison between the L&D function and P&E teams building or supporting simulation tooling — writing clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria on the learning side. Serve as a product owner for L&D outcomes.
Partner with facilitators and trainers to pressure-test simulations before rollout, incorporating live-delivery feedback into design and technical iteration.
Translate technical/platform constraints (data privacy, integration limits, latency, model behavior) into design trade-offs that instructional design and facilitation stakeholders can understand and plan around.
Represent L&D in Product/Engineering planning processes where simulation tooling, data, or infrastructure decisions affect training outcomes.
Innovation & Process Ownership
Pioneer AI-driven design and production processes that let the team scale simulation output while maintaining quality — this role owns how simulations get built, not just what gets built.
Stay current on emerging AI tools and techniques relevant to simulation and instructional design, and make the call on when to adopt, pilot, or pass.
Measurement & Continuous Improvement
Define and track success metrics for each simulation (e.g., time-to-competency, skill transfer, manager/coach ratings, performance-data correlation), not just completion or satisfaction scores.
Use practice and performance analytics to identify where simulations are and aren’t closing real skill gaps, and iterate accordingly.
Report on simulation program impact to L&D leadership, tying results to business outcomes rather than production speed alone.
Governance & Quality
Ensure simulations meet accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG, Section 508) and organizational data privacy/security requirements for any AI tool used.
Establish and maintain a quality/review process for AI-generated simulation content before it reaches learners.

We want someone who lives at the intersection of learning design and technology. You’ll thrive here if:
You have 7+ years in instructional design, learning experience design, or a closely related L&D role.

You have demonstrated experience creating AI-generated learning assets, specifically simulations, chatbots, branching scenarios, role-play conversations, assessments, and coaching/reinforcement activities (a portfolio or work samples demonstrating this is required).
You have experience partnering directly with P&E teams or other technical partners in their planning process, and you communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
You have experience designing for and/or delivering live facilitation (virtual or in-person), or working closely with facilitators to pressure-test and shape training content before rollout.
You have experience translating business priorities and performance gaps into scalable learning solutions, ideally in a fast-paced or customer-facing organization.
You have a strong grounding in instructional design methodology (e.g., ADDIE, adult learning theory) and scenario/branching-logic design.
You have working proficiency with at least one AI simulation/role-play platform (e.g., Second Nature, Hyperbound, Mindtickle, Zenarate, SmartWinnr, or comparable) and one standard authoring/content tool stack (e.g., Articulate Storyline/Rise, Vyond, Claude Design) with AI-assisted features.
You’re familiar with the systems a Product/Engineering-adjacent L&D role needs to operate in: an LMS (e.g., Cornerstone, Absorb, Moodle), a CMS (e.g., Showpad), and a project-tracking tool used by Engineering (e.g., Jira) — enough to work inside these systems, not just consume their output.

About Us
Climate Lead empowers philanthropic leaders everywhere to take immediate and far-reaching climate action. Climate Lead equips new climate philanthropists with the information and insights they need to drive transformative solutions by serving as an impartial guide. We cut through the complexity by curating roadmaps in partnership with a diverse network of experts to help philanthropists make a bold impact on climate from day one.
Summary
The Manager, Advisory serves as a strategic partner, proxy, and force multiplier for the advisory-related work of Climate Lead’s President, Jennifer Kitt.
The focus of this role is on the President’s impact across advising and donor engagement by coordinating cross-functional workflows, establishing clear tracking systems, and ensuring high-priority donor engagements, ambassador relationships, and organizational initiatives move with speed, rigor, and clarity. On a day-to-day basis, this position prepares presidential briefings, tracks follow-through across teams, synthesizes post-meeting insights, handles data entry, and builds scalable processes.
Reporting directly to the Associate Director, Advisory, this role serves as the critical operational bridge linking the President’s priorities with the broader Advisory Team. Sitting at the intersection of strategy and execution, the ideal candidate combines high-signal coordination, startup-style operational agility, executive presence, exceptional writing, and the ability to influence without authority.
This role has no direct reports or managerial responsibilities.
Core Responsibilities
Coordination & Stakeholder Partnership
Information Synthesis: Gather inputs from across the organization and distill the information into clear, prioritized context and actionable next steps for Presidential initiatives.
Advisory Team Collaborative Workflow: Partner collaboratively with the Advisory team so the President enters high-stakes engagements equipped with context, while ensuring post-meeting insights and agreed-upon action items are synthesized and seamlessly routed to leaders for ongoing stewardship.
Coordination & Execution: Serve as an operational bridge across teams by coordinating deliverables, driving follow-through on cross-functional commitments, and resolving workflow bottlenecks before they reach the President.
President’s Office Team Orchestration: Serve as a key connector across the President’s support ecosystem, partnering seamlessly with the Associate Director, Executive Operations (Board & executive operations) and the Executive Assistant (logistics/calendar), to drive unified information flow, alignment, and execution.
Strategic Project Management
Drive Strategic Velocity: Turn ambiguous executive ideas and high-level strategic conversations into structured, trackable workstreams with clear owners, deliverables, and deadlines.
Process Design & Streamlining: Maintain and improve processes and leverage Salesforce, Asana, and modern productivity tools to track the President’s portfolio, donor commitments, and key deliverables with high precision.
Efficiency & AI Integration: Identify opportunities to integrate strategic automation, AI tools, and digital workflows that maximize executive efficiency and information velocity.
High-Stakes Proxy & Executive Synthesis
Meeting Presence & Capture: Attend select donor, partner, and ambassador meetings alongside the President to capture strategic nuance, synthesize insights, and drive follow-up.
Executive Writing & Communications: Draft presidential-level briefings, donor summaries, and follow-ups that authentically capture the President’s strategic voice, tone, and intent.
Routing: Serve as a strategic filter for the President, routing internal and external advisory requests so time is reserved for the highest-leverage decision points and donor opportunities.
Key Competencies for Success
Stakeholder Coordination & Diplomacy: You excel at capturing complex information from multiple stakeholders, separating signal from noise, and building collaborative, trust-based alignment across teams.
Operational Rigor: You bring structure to ambiguity and delight in turning complex workstreams into smooth, predictable processes.
Global Context & Stakeholder Nuance: You navigate high-consequence environments and ultra-high-net-worth relationships with exceptional discretion and high emotional intelligence.
Executive Tone & Writing: You write with clarity, gravitas, and nuance, quickly adopting an executive’s voice and converting dense discussions into concise executive summaries.
Agile & Tech-Forward: You naturally seek out modern tools, AI, and digital workflows to eliminate friction and multiply your personal bandwidth and organizational impact.
Qualifications
5–8+ years of experience in strategic operations, Chief of Staff support, customer success, impact investing, or high-touch gift advising/fundraising.
Domain Context: Prior climate or philanthropy experience is welcome, but not required. We strongly encourage applications from fast-paced corporate, startup, or consulting environments where candidates demonstrate rapid domain learning, complex stakeholder coordination, and execution rigor.
Global & UHNW Stakeholder Experience: Demonstrated poise, discretion, and effectiveness navigating complex environments and engaging high-stakes stakeholders, such as ultra-high-net-worth individuals, global influencers, or executive leadership.
Proven Project & Systems Management: Strong fluency in CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce), project management platforms (e.g., Asana), and modern AI/productivity platforms.
Location: San Francisco, CA (Hybrid: Tuesday–Thursday in-office).
Salary Range: $ 144,000 - $160,000
